resources.string: Pay and get paid with a single gesture
The amount is already filled in: all that is left is your PIN.
Your accounts together in a single app, to pay or to receive.
Your money stays with your operator
Eifi never holds it and never sees your PIN.
What do you want to do with Eifi?
You can do both. Choose where to start.
At a shop or to a friend, by tapping your phone or scanning their code.
Receive payments from your customers or relatives, without typing their number.
